summary: SPEC-03 is blocked on the owner's sanitized captures (G1), and sanitizing by hand is slow and easy to get wrong. This adds one read-only command that produces them: it logs each enabled registry account in through the fleet factory (same credential handling and LogScrubber as --baseline), calls only read-only Client methods (getShipByUserId, listAllCharactersOfUser, listItemsOfAShip, findUserRanking, listPvPBattles2 take=25) and keeps the profile and GetLatestVersion3 settings that login already holds. An expired session raises instead of logging in again.  sdk/state/capture.py sanitizes every response before anything is written: secret fields become ***REDACTED***, Id/AccountId/*UserId values become stable per-account USER-* placeholders, player/ship/alliance names become PLAYER-*/SHIP-*/ALLIANCE-*, and any value redact_secrets, the account's credential values or the scan would flag is redacted. It then applies the S03-R2 scan (duplicated as scan_capture_text, kept in step with tests/test_profile_reads.py by a parity test); a response that does not scan clean is withheld and only the rule is reported. Output is <alias>/<endpoint>.xml plus a manifest with README-ready rows; the output directory must be new and outside tests/fixtures/, so the owner reviews and copies files in. Implemented by the capture builder specialist subagent in an isolated worktree, independently reviewed by the verifier subagent (tests cite S03-R1, S03-R2; parent re-validated in a scratch clone), and re-validated by the parent.
